decision_basis: The independent DAS-only development scan recovered both known local Parkfield earthquakes as the two strongest and most spatially coherent triggers while missing the network's distant regional arrival. A disclosed version-2 support gate mechanically retains those two and rejects the other 63 development triggers without changing the v1 score threshold. This is post-hoc tuning, not validation; no DAS-only catalog extension or family assignment has yet been demonstrated. The network-first held-out operating point is now registered with zero held-out waveform or catalog access.

project_shape.question: Can deep near-source DAS distinguish M00413 from M00414, or support their merger, better than the conventional array?
Does a DAS-only or joint continuous scan recover independently adjudicated events missed by a fair same-interval network-only detector?
